read_gap.handling: Archive No-Read Fence preserved. Do not infer stale derived state; formal authority remains controlled by fresh MISSION_STATE outside this review, while this artifact reviews exact-current executable v1/v2/v2.1 files only.

agreements: v2.1 separates verified_experience_delta from operational_progress_delta at the output boundary.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only in the current v2.1 path.
Heartbeat/poll/retry/wait/scheduler wake remain zero Experience in inherited v2 semantics.
Anti-thrash cannot block an inherited safety/recovery downshift because the hold only applies when selected_n > current_n.
v2.1 keeps formal_mutation_allowed=false and therefore has no direct formal mutation authority.
The v2.1 contract correctly marks speedup as NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and names paired operational metrics rather than commit count.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are free caller inputs rather than values derived from a trusted freshness/authority envelope. The executable has no timestamp, TTL, source fingerprint, authority snapshot hash, replay protection, or provider identity check.
disagreements.required_change: For live/adoptable mode derive freshness/conflict inside a trusted host boundary from a SecretarySignalEnvelope bound to signal hash, source identity, issued/observed time, freshness-policy hash, exact fresh authority snapshot hash and replay-resistant acceptance state.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience credit is controlled by event_kind plus a free verification flag. No exact evidence hash, independent verifier identity/role, verification receipt, mission/step binding, installation/workspace binding, revocation, or freshness is checked.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a structured verifier receipt bound to exact canonical event/evidence bytes, verifier identity/role, policy, mission/step, installation/workspace identity, acceptance state and revocation/freshness.

disagreements.finding: Both aggregate_experience_events() and select_gear_v2_1() apply Python bool(...) to independently_verified/event_independently_verified. Therefore non-empty strings such as 'false' or '0', non-empty lists and objects become True and can directly create verified Experience credit for verified event kinds.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool verification values fail-closed before any credit calculation. This strict typing is necessary but still insufficient without the evidence-bound verifier receipt required by QV-GB21-VERIFIED-EVIDENCE-BINDING-002.

disagreements.finding: Experience ledger dedupe keys only on caller-provided event_id. The same underlying event/evidence can be replayed under arbitrarily many new event_ids and credited repeatedly.
disagreements.required_change: Deduplicate on canonical event/evidence lineage identity and verifier receipt identity; event_id may remain an index but cannot be the uniqueness authority.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio>=0.50 suppresses any nonessential upshift, but the value has no sample count, observation window, exposure denominator, confidence bound, or provenance. One shift in one observation is indistinguishable from a stable high-rate regime.
disagreements.required_change: Bind the ratio to a versioned observation window plus sufficient-support metadata and release/cooldown semantics. Numeric thresholds and minimum sample sizes remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: The hold can keep current_gear indefinitely whenever the externally supplied shift rate remains high. Safety downshifts are preserved, but required safe upshifts can be delayed with no maximum hold, confidence decay, recovery bound, or service-level non-regression test.
disagreements.required_change: Add bounded hold/release semantics and paired performance tests proving cycle latency, verified closure throughput and recovery latency do not regress materially while safety behavior is preserved.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is caller-supplied and currently only changes a reason string, which is safer than routing reinforcement. However it has no denominator/window/independent derivation and must not later become an upshift reinforcement signal without causal controls.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from verified closures over a precommitted denominator/window; any behavioral use requires ablation and anti-self-reinforcement tests.

disagreements.finding: Credit weights 5/4/3 and operational weight 1 are engineering heuristics. Equal sums from different event mixes are not calibrated equivalence of capability, truth, trust or personality growth.
disagreements.required_change: Explicitly prohibit aggregate score from serving as capability truth, trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold without separate calibration. All weights remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: The contract names appropriate speed metrics but there is no executable paired-baseline protocol, matched workload, precommit, uncertainty estimate, observation horizon, or non-inferiority rule yet.
disagreements.required_change: Require matched baseline/candidate runs using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, with equal-or-better verification/risk quality. Commit count, wake count and awake time are forbidden speed evidence.

statistical_risks: recent_shift_rate_ratio lacks denominator/window/sample-size semantics and is vulnerable to small-n false positives.
verified_progress_density lacks denominator/window/independence semantics and may suffer selection bias if only successful closures are recorded.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate mechanically while worsening cycle latency, recovery latency or verified closures.
Credit weights 5/4/3 are ordinal heuristics rather than interval-scale capability measurements.
Speed comparison without matched workloads is confounded by task mix, incident rate, verifier availability, route complexity and window/runtime conditions.
More ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND events can mean a worse system rather than capability improvement, so operational progress volume is not a monotonic quality measure.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001: stale RED/ORANGE signal with caller-forged secretary_signal_fresh=true must fail closed absent a trusted freshness envelope.
GB21-AUTHORITY-CONFLICT-002: secretary signal conflicting with a newer authority snapshot must be ignored even if caller supplies authority_conflict=false.
GB21-FRESHNESS-CLOCK-003: timestamp rollback/forward jump, expired TTL and replayed secretary envelope cannot regain freshness.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004: 1/1 and 2/3 observations cannot trigger production anti-thrash absent precommitted minimum-support semantics; threshold/sample policy TEST_REQUIRED.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005: transient shift burst followed by stable demand must allow bounded-time safe upshift while cycle latency and verified closure throughput remain non-regressed.
GB21-SAFETY-UPSHIFT-006: a predeclared safe-service upshift cannot be indefinitely suppressed by stale shift-rate history.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1.0 supplied by caller cannot confer routing, Experience, promotion or authority effects.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008: the same canonical evidence replayed under 10,000 distinct event_ids credits exactly once.
GB21-VERIFIER-BOOL-COERCION-009: 'false', '0', non-empty list, mapping, object and integer verification values must be rejected fail-closed in both direct decision and ledger paths.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-010: verified event without exact evidence hash and trusted verifier receipt receives zero verified credit.
GB21-CROSS-EVENT-EVIDENCE-011: two event_ids bound to the same canonical evidence/verifier receipt count once; one event_id rebound to different evidence is an identity conflict.

GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-012: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND change only operational progress; verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance and formal authority remain byte-identical.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-013: equal aggregate credit assembled from different event mixes cannot be interpreted as equivalent capability and cannot alone trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-014: matched baseline vs candidate workload reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency and verification/risk non-regression; commit count/wake duration excluded.
GB21-V1-V2-NONREGRESSION-015: verified v1 baseline and current v2 regression suite remain preserved before any v2.1 adoption claim.
release_condition: This review does not claim C PASS and does not modify formal/code state.
Fresh secretary influence must be derived from replay-resistant trusted freshness evidence and exact authority snapshot comparison, not caller booleans.
Verification flags must be strict booleans and verified Experience must additionally require exact evidence hash plus trusted independent-verifier/C receipt and identity binding.
Experience dedupe must resist same-event/new-ID replay using canonical evidence lineage identity.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and cannot promote verified Experience, P_base or authority.
Anti-thrash requires TEST_REQUIRED window/sample support and bounded recovery/performance non-regression while preserving immediate safety downshift.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and tested against self-reinforcement and selection bias.
5/4/3 weights remain heuristic; total credit cannot be used as capability truth or promotion threshold without independent calibration.

Any speedup claim requires paired matched baseline evidence over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk quality.
Formal adoption still requires exact-current regression evidence, adversarial review, Navigator synthesis and the existing A->B->C route.
next_lane: After this latest-only review and readback, return to Always-on Runtime / Small-World only when exact authority/endpoint permits; W02 performs no formal mutation.
